messages:
Anika Patel: Heads up — customer asks: per-tenant retention exports + longer SOC2 evidence windows (up to 3 yrs) as paid add-on. Need a prioritized plan for Q3 roadmap by Fri.
Raj Chen: Are we talking export API + stored evidence TTL extension, or just manual exports for enterprise? Need to scope cost/risk.
Anika Patel: Both. Prefer an automated export endpoint plus a retention tier. Customers want: export on demand, legal_hold, and automated monthly evidence bundles.
Mike Torres: Storage + egress costs are the main driver. Quick estimate: 3yr retention for all audit logs ~ 4x current spend. Per-tenant keying (KMS) adds ~10% CPU on writes.
Olivia Grant: From Legal: retention length depends on contract/region. Some customers will require 5–7 years. We need a configurable policy plus audit trail for any deletions.
James Wu: HSM is sticky. For courts/regulated customers they want attestable keys in an HSM. We can start with KMS (customer-managed keys) and offer HSM as an enterprise upgrade.
Raj Chen: Tech constraints: privacy deletion semantics, export format (NDJSON vs zip of JSON + manifests), and rekeying strategy. Also need to avoid double-encrypting for exports.
Mike Torres: Proposed export API v1:
```
POST /v1/tenant/{id}/export
body: {"range": {"from":"2024-01-01","to":"2026-01-01"}, "include_evidence": true}
response: 202 accepted -> job id -> downloadable s3 link
```
Anika Patel: Nice. Launch criteria idea:
- API implemented + docs
- Canary with 2 enterprise tenants
- KMS support in hosted + private
- Automated evidence packaging for the 6 controls in SOC2 in our baseline
- Cost model & billing item created
Olivia Grant: Also need legal_hold flag + immutable export logs (who requested, timestamp, and justification). That counts for evidence of controls.
James Wu: Operational readiness: playbook for export incident (huge export causing throttling), retention audit dashboard, and HSM onboarding checklist (attestation steps).
Raj Chen: Prioritization: 1) Export API + legal_hold + baseline packaging 2) KMS customer keys 3) Retention tiers UI + billing 4) HSM onboarding + attestation (Q4)
Anika Patel: Action items:
- Raj: produce tech design with rekey/deletion semantics (due Wed)
- Mike: cost model & S3 lifecycle options (due Wed)
- Olivia: sample contract language + regulatory matrix (due Thu)
- James: ops runbook + canary checklist (due Thu)
security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence automation RFC draft is overdue. Pinged @Raj Chen and @James Wu.
Anika Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll synthesize into a roadmap slide for Leadership review on Monday. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
